steps.name: Dockworker
steps.text: What are you shipping?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Wine.

steps.name: Dockworker
steps.text: Waybill number?

steps.name: Dockworker
steps.text: What's the company?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Sorry. Don't know what you mean.

steps.name: Dockworker
steps.text: The goods you're hauling there. What corporation owns them? How's that hard to understand?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Haha. You must be new. Doesn't understand how things work around here.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: S'alright. Listen and learn. You should ask, 'What famiglia are you with?'

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Sorry, signore. What's the company?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: ...Saluzzo Vino.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Right. Your information checks out. Go on ahead.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Don't look at me like that, and don't try to bring the old ways over here. Look at the sign above the port.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: You're in Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Boss, you came just in time. I got something to discuss with you.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: We're not taking any trucks out today. We're gonna fix up the roads around camp.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: If Sandro blows another tire next time he backs up, he'll have no one to blame but his own bad luck, haha.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: Also, the custom-made tent has arrived. We're planning to set it up near the western exit.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: The new campsite is huge. There's room for the awning, water purification system, and barbecue grill. It's in a relatively quiet area, which should help the new recruits adjust more easily.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: I also added an outdoor projector screen so that the people in the camp can enjoy a little entertainment.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: When I have time, I'll go rent some Wrankwood films... I know what you're gonna say—no mafia flicks.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: By the way, I heard city hall has already started building a new resettlement area?

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: Haha, well, they'd better hurry up—otherwise, I might not want to move out when the time comes.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: Right now, the trucks can only park in the camp. Everyone has to live in the trucks. It's really inconvenient, especially for guys with families...

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: But at least we don't have to deal with those big Families anymore. These trucks belong to us. Standing together to protect them gives us a sense of security.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Sometimes I look at the camp over there and think, 'Who would believe that this was a barren wasteland just a year ago?'

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: By the way, boss, why didn't you come back last night?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: You all distracted me. I almost forgot what I was doing here!

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Bring me the district heads—Sandro, Ginter, Sommer...

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Sommer isn't here.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Huh? Isn't he off work today?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I told him so many times already, I get why he wants to bring Guri to Nuova Volsinii for treatment as soon as possible.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Guri is my little sister too. I told him I'd do my part to help. I told him to stop taking extra long hauls all the time.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Boss, don't get mad. It's probably not what you think.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: What about the unlucky loner?

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: She isn't here either. I haven't seen her since last night.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: That's weird. Whatever. Gather up everybody still in camp. We need to help Judge Lavinia investigate some things.
The sun is shining brightly.
The cordoned-off area has turned the bustling street quiet. Bloodstains mingle with the tire tracks on the ground as police officers rush back and forth.
Nuova Volsinii is not as rainy as the other cities in Siracusa. Without the rain to obscure it, the accident scene stands out all the more strikingly.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: ...Have you made any more progress?

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: The surveillance around here is broken, so we could not obtain any video footage. We were forced to scour the area for physical evidence.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Here you can see the tire marks left by Signor Bellone's car and the other vehicle that has since left the scene.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: The collision occurred at a corner where there's a bad blind spot. There's also a traffic light there though, so the two cars shouldn't have collided. And yet, both veered oddly at almost the same moment—

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: That's when Signor Bellone's car was struck by the other vehicle, which quickly fled the scene.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: It may have been a routine traffic accident, but we cannot exclude the possibility that it was...

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Have you learned anything new about our mystery vehicle?

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: It's just as we concluded last night—a large box truck of some sort.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I see. Delivery trucks, shuttle buses, fire trucks, specialized construction vehicles... 'Box trucks' of this size are rare in Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I've already asked Eirene to help me investigate. The truck drivers are much better equipped than we are to find clues.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Judge Lavinia, Signor Bellone...

steps.name: Private Physician
steps.text: The fractures and internal bleeding have been addressed through surgery, but the severe concussion has left the patient in a coma, at least for now.

steps.name: Private Physician
steps.text: In a sense, we can't say the patient is out of mortal danger yet.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Will... will he recover?

steps.name: Private Physician
steps.text: As a doctor, I will not promise anything... However, as a citizen of Nuova Volsinii, I sincerely hope Signor Bellone makes a full recovery, and I'll do my best to make that happen.

steps.name: Private Physician
steps.text: I wish you the best of luck, Judge Lavinia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: They did it. They made a move...

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Judge Lavinia, should we go grab some of the mafiosi, and then—

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Don't even think about it.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That's the famiglie's way; it is not our way.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Forgive me! But I think if anyone had a reason to harm Signor Bellone, it would be one of those famiglia bastards!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: We shall find the culprit, no matter who they are. They must be brought to justice.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But who could it be?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The Saluzzos?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The Venezias?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The Medicis?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The Leotis?
Lavinia turns her gaze to the restaurant on the corner.
The restaurant is small, and the seats by the window face the middle of the road.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Demetri invited me to dinner tonight and I promised him I'd be there. I can't keep avoiding him forever, Lavinia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Leon, what is wrong with all this...?

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: Signor Antonio, I've already trimmed the stray fur on your ears and tail. The next step is applying the conditioner.

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: This might take a little while. Feel free to close your eyes and rest for a spell.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: No problem. You just do your thing.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Is this your first time here?

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: Yes, yes it is. Carle said if your own personal nurse had not fallen ill... well, in any case it's my honor to serve you today.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Don't be nervous. You're doing a great job.

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: Thank you. Heh.

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: Our family has spent generations studying Lupo fur. We started as traveling craftsmen and eventually opened the first grooming center. It's been hundreds of years, and we've gathered plenty of expertise along the way!

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: Lupo fur is generally coarse with inner and outer layers, while Perro fur is much finer and softer. At first glance, they may seem similar, but in reality, they're worlds apart.

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: That's why I specially formulated this conditioning treatment for you. Its blend of rich botanical essences can help firm up the fur while still retaining key nutrients.

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: What do you think? Do you like it?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Of course. You've put so much care into this whole thing. Why wouldn't I be happy with it?

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: Signor Antonio, you are kind and gentle. You're not at all as scary as Carle said...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: I think there must have been some misunderstanding. I'm just a simple businessman. Who would do business with a scary man?

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: Haha... By the way, Signor Antonio, would you like to try a semi-permanent styling for your ears and tail?

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: That way, their shape will be more defined and look better. Plus, no one will be able to tell you aren't a Lupo—

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Oh... hold on.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: It sounds like you have strong opinions about my ears and tail.

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: Well, I heard Carle say you wanted to look more like a Lupo.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Hah. You mean to say that I, as a lowly Perro, should rather look more like my own race?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: What kinda beastshit are you talking?!

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: Carle?

steps.name: Chatty Grooming Specialist
steps.text: I... I just wanted to show Signor Antonio here—

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: That's enough, shut your face! Get outta here!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Scusa, Antonio...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Don't worry about it. Not your fault.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Here's our shipping invoice for this month.
Antonio quickly scans the invoice and puts an 'X' on the signature line.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: A batch of 'tires' is arriving at the warehouse today, and you're in charge of inspection, aren't you? Why are you still at the estate?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: I'll head over right away. Don't worry, nothing will go wrong.
Where are we...? Wait...
Lemme go! Why did you bring me here?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Quiet, ragazzo!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Keep yellin' and I'll color the rest of your face to match that black eye!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Capone, keep an eye on him. I gotta go tell the boss.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Boss, we got a problem.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: There was a car accident at the port last night. Leontuzzo got hurt.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: The Acting Mayor! That's big news, but what does it have to do with us?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: The truck that hit Leontuzzo was hauling our 'tires'.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: It drove off before we could even answer.
The man paces the room, his heavy footsteps drowning out the sound of his labored breathing.
He walks over to the large oak cask and quickly downs three cups of brandy.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Antonio, right now you should be...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Wait, wait, wait. I despise impatience. It clouds our judgment.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Were there witnesses at the scene?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Just one. Capone and I brought him back here.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Good work.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Now, listen to me carefully:

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: First, keep an eye on everyone in the household. If anyone goes somewhere they shouldn't be going or is doing a job they shouldn't be doing, bring them to me immediately.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Keep a close watch on the other famiglie in the city—the Saluzzos, the Medicis, the Leotis... Figure out which famiglia seems the most nervous. They're the ones who made the move on Leontuzzo.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: I want to know who, at this particular moment in time, is so eager to upset the apple cart.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: And the truck from the accident... are we just not gonna look for it, or?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Go look for it, but don't do anything too drastic.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: As long as the truck itself wasn't defective, what does it matter who was driving, what cargo was being transported, or how it's connected to Venezia Trucking?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Go and reassure some of our other 'friendly' truck drivers. Those long-haulers are more prone to losing their composure than the average man.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Alright. I'll get right to it.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Wait a sec, Carle.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Gambino, you handle this. Bring some of the boys with you.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You got it, boss.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Antonio, I—I'm sorry. It was my mistake.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: No one could have predicted that sort of thing would happen.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: You're supremely talented, Carle. You've been in this famiglia longer than I have. You oversee half the vehicle repair stations in Montelupe.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: If I were you, I'd probably be wondering myself: how ever would that Perro, Antonio, get so many opportunities, getting to manage the business of the new city on his own, if he hadn't married the old man's daughter?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: I... don't...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Listen to me, Carle. All the cities, including Nuova Volsinii, have to follow the rules. Those who do not follow the rules... well... they don't get to walk away with decency.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: This is what the Don told me, and now I'm telling it to you.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Please give me another chance, Antonio.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: The Don should arrive in Nuova Volsinii in the next day or two. I don't want him to be bothered with this nonsense, got it?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: O—Of course, Signore! Thank you!

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Wait a second. There's one more thing we need to discuss.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: That grooming specialist I had just now. I really don't like him.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: I got it. I'll fire him at once.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: No, no. I don't mean that I dislike his work. I don't like him, personally.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: ...I got it. You won't see him again.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Did you find it?

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: Nope. We looked through several parking lots but didn't find any trucks that looked like they had been in an accident.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: The Truckers' Union owns thousands of vehicles, and almost none of them have been idle these past few days. If we checked them one by one, we wouldn't finish until after Carnevale was over!

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: Boss, Judge Lavinia asked you to help find clues, but now you're targeting the Truckers' Union? It's almost like you think one of us hit the Mayor's car...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: When it comes to big box trucks in Nuova Volsinii, who is more involved than us?

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: There are plenty of other groups involved! There are the vehicle factories, the repair stations, the Nuova Volsinii Port...

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: Besides, none of our trucks passed through that intersection at the time of the accident!

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Alright, Pedro. Obviously, I do not believe the folks from the union would do something like that. This is just for peace of mind.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Signor Bellone and Judge Lavinia are both good people, are they not?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Proving that we had nothing to do with this will save them a lot of time and effort. It'll help the police solve the case faster and find the real culprit!

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: That's true...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: By the way, have you gotten in touch with Sommer? He's covering several districts in the south, so having him check things out would be quicker.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Strange... Never mind, let's focus on what's at hand first.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: Alright, we'll keep searching.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Who is it?

steps.name: Terrified Truck Driver
steps.text: Eirene? It's... it's me.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Sommer, you've been here, in the camp?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Didn't you hear what we were talking about? Why didn't you come out?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Why are your clothes all torn... and what's with the scratches on your face?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Last night...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: That truck that hit Leontuzzo last night.... don't tell me...

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Yes... I was the driver...
